mainEntity.name: Do zoning codes and HOA guidelines restrict building granny apartments in Tampa Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local zoning codes and building department rules dictate where and how secondary suites can be built across Hillsborough, Pinellas, and surrounding counties. Requirements establish mandatory property line setbacks, lot coverage limits, building height caps, and parking space minimums. Municipalities also specify whether a secondary unit can include a full cooking range or only a basic kitchenette. Before drawing plans, a contractor must check your local municipal jurisdiction and HOA rules to confirm allowable square footage and structure placement for your neighborhood.
